unit: independent original image cluster; one primary image-prompt condition per slot
scope_note: 240 is a prospective allocation, not an acquired image-prompt dataset. Every URI, identity and hash must be bound to a real reviewed asset before source freezing.

FROZEN_CONFIRMATION.use_after: method, system background, metrics, margins, N and analysis are frozen

primary_stratum_assignment.rule: First assign explicitly stylized/abstract images to S12. For other images choose the predeclared dominant intended subject or whole-scene task. Animal/vehicle/object categories use that subject; whole-scene tasks use S09/S10/S11. Record secondary objects separately. Adjudicate ambiguity before any candidate result. Camera, motion, texture and lighting never create an additional primary stratum.
primary_stratum_assignment.same_image_multiple_prompts: One primary condition per independent cluster. Any extra diagnostic prompt stays in the same role and cluster and is reported as a within-cluster condition, not a new source.

strata.primary_image_acceptance: 写实画面中以一名人物为主要语义对象；允许背景路人，不能让多人关系成为主任务。人物关节、脸或手部须按子题可辨。

image_requirements: 一名人物站立或行走，身体与前进方向有足够画面空间。
prompt_examples: The person takes several natural steps forward and then turns their head to the side.
The person slowly turns around and walks a short distance away.

image_requirements: 一名人物上半身清晰，双臂至少一侧可见，周围有抬手空间。
prompt_examples: The person raises one hand, waves gently, and lowers it again.
The person stretches both arms outward and then relaxes them.

image_requirements: 一名人物脸部可辨，初始表情中性或自然，脸不被大面积遮挡。
prompt_examples: The person blinks, looks to one side, and gives a small smile.
The person slowly tilts their head and changes from a neutral expression to a smile.

image_requirements: 一名人物与纸笔在画面中，书写手和纸面均可辨。
prompt_examples: The person writes a short line on the paper and briefly lifts the pen.
The person moves the pen across the paper while their other hand keeps the page in place.

image_requirements: 一名人物持有乐器，接触位置与手臂可见。
prompt_examples: The person gently plays the visible instrument with coordinated hand movements.
The person continues playing the instrument and slightly sways with the rhythm.

image_requirements: 一名人物呈可继续运动的姿态，全身或相关肢体可辨。
prompt_examples: The person bends their knees, straightens up, and settles into a balanced stance.
The person shifts their weight from one leg to the other and takes a controlled side step.

image_requirements: 一名人物正在处理布料、纸张或小物，双手及对象均可辨。
prompt_examples: The person carefully folds the visible material and smooths it with their hands.
The person lifts an edge of the material, adjusts it, and lays it back down.

image_requirements: 一名人物、烹饪容器和工具均可辨，工具与容器位置合理。
prompt_examples: The person slowly stirs the contents of the visible container with the utensil.
The person lifts the utensil slightly and then resumes stirring the container.

strata.primary_image_acceptance: 写实画面中至少两名人物共同承担主任务；关系、协同或群体运动须能从图像和最终prompt同时识别。

image_requirements: 至少两人相向或彼此接近，脸或上身可见。
prompt_examples: The people exchange small gestures while taking turns looking at each other.
One person nods while the other makes a brief hand gesture in response.

image_requirements: 两人之间有一个已存在、可辨的小物，手部与传递间距合理。
prompt_examples: One person carefully passes the visible object to the other person.
The people bring their hands closer and complete a careful handover of the object.

image_requirements: 两人或多人围绕同一已存在任务对象，接触位置可辨。
prompt_examples: The people coordinate their hands to adjust the shared object together.
The people gently move the shared object while watching each other.

image_requirements: 两人或多人并排或同向，腿部与道路空间可辨。
prompt_examples: The people walk forward together at a relaxed pace.
The people take a few steps together and briefly turn toward one another.

image_requirements: 多名人物和必要运动物件已存在，姿态支持短时协调动作。
prompt_examples: The players shift position and react to the visible ball or shared activity.
The players make a short coordinated movement while keeping their attention on the activity.

image_requirements: 多人身体可辨，肢体有足够活动空间。
prompt_examples: The people make a small coordinated dance movement and return to a steady stance.
The group moves side to side with a shared rhythm.

image_requirements: 至少五个人物形成群体，近景与远景人物可区分。
prompt_examples: The crowd moves slowly through the scene, with individuals taking different small steps.
People in the crowd shift position and occasionally turn their heads.

image_requirements: 两人有合理的辅助或接触姿态，手臂和接触部位可辨。
prompt_examples: One person steadies the other as they take a careful step.
The people gently adjust their grip and settle into a more stable position.

strata.primary_image_acceptance: 写实陆生非飞行动物为主体；鸟、飞行昆虫与水生动物归S04，避免按同一动物当次是否移动重复分类。

image_requirements: 犬类主体完整或关键四肢可见，地面与前进空间清楚。
prompt_examples: The dog walks a few steps, pauses, and turns its head.
The dog slowly approaches and briefly sniffs the ground.

image_requirements: 猫类头部和至少部分身体可见，姿态支持轻微动作。
prompt_examples: The cat blinks, turns its ears, and slowly moves its tail.
The cat lifts its head and begins gently grooming a paw.

image_requirements: 马或相近大型四足动物可辨，地面空间足够。
prompt_examples: The horse takes several measured steps while its mane moves slightly.
The horse shifts its weight and lowers its head before stepping forward.

image_requirements: 食草动物与草、叶或饲料同时存在，头部可见。
prompt_examples: The animal lowers its head and slowly grazes on the visible plants.
The animal chews, lifts its head briefly, and returns to grazing.

image_requirements: 小型哺乳动物与停留表面可辨，前爪或嘴部不过小。
prompt_examples: The small animal holds the visible item and makes quick, gentle nibbling movements.
The small animal looks around and makes a short movement along the surface.

image_requirements: 蜥蜴、龟或相近爬行动物，身体轮廓与支撑面清楚。
prompt_examples: The reptile slowly moves forward and slightly turns its head.
The reptile extends its neck and adjusts its position on the surface.

image_requirements: 蛙或相近两栖动物，初始姿态与可落脚区域可辨。
prompt_examples: The frog makes a small body movement and then settles back into place.
The frog turns slightly and adjusts its front legs.

image_requirements: 蚂蚁、蜗牛、甲虫等地面无脊椎动物，主体须足够大以辨动作。
prompt_examples: The small ground animal moves steadily across the visible surface.
The small animal changes direction while continuing along the surface.

strata.label_zh: 鸟类、飞行昆虫与水生动物
strata.primary_image_acceptance: 写实鸟类、飞行昆虫、鱼或其他水生动物为主体；按生物类别分层，不以生成后的运动结果归类。

image_requirements: 鸟停于可辨支撑物，头、身体与翅膀边界可见。
prompt_examples: The bird turns its head, ruffles its feathers, and adjusts its footing.
The bird briefly opens its wings and settles back on the perch.

image_requirements: 鸟已在空中或处于明确可起飞姿态，翅膀和飞行空间可见。
prompt_examples: The bird continues flying with smooth wing beats across the scene.
The bird glides forward and makes a slight turn.

image_requirements: 蝴蝶或可飞行昆虫可辨，翅膀不被严重裁断。
prompt_examples: The insect slowly opens and closes its wings while remaining near the visible plant.
The insect makes a short, gentle flight and stays close to its starting area.

image_requirements: 一条主要鱼类主体可辨，水体中有足够游动空间。
prompt_examples: The fish swims forward with gentle movements of its tail and fins.
The fish slowly changes direction while maintaining a smooth swimming motion.

image_requirements: 多条鱼形成可辨群体，背景避免完全遮蔽轮廓。
prompt_examples: The fish move together while keeping small differences in spacing and direction.
The school of fish gently curves through the water.

image_requirements: 水母或柔性水生动物完整可辨，触须与主体至少部分清楚。
prompt_examples: The jellyfish pulses gently and drifts through the water.
The soft-bodied animal slowly contracts and expands while its appendages trail behind.

image_requirements: 海洋哺乳动物主体可辨，水面或水下环境与姿态一致。
prompt_examples: The marine animal moves forward smoothly and slightly turns its body.
The marine animal rises gently and then continues along its path.

image_requirements: 水底爬行或附着动物及所在表面可辨。
prompt_examples: The animal makes a slow movement along the underwater surface.
The animal gently moves its visible limbs or appendages while staying near the bottom.

strata.primary_image_acceptance: 汽车、自行车、摩托、公共车辆或铁路车辆承担主要语义；骑手若只是载体附属保留S05，主要人物动作则归S01/S02。

image_requirements: 自行车与路面可辨，车轮和前进空间不被裁断。
prompt_examples: The bicycle moves forward steadily as its wheels rotate.
The bicycle rolls slowly and makes a gentle turn along the road.

image_requirements: 摩托车完整可辨，人与车的初始关系合理。
prompt_examples: The motorcycle advances smoothly along the visible road.
The motorcycle rolls forward with a slight change in direction.

image_requirements: 主要汽车与路面可辨，车前或车后留有运动空间。
prompt_examples: The car drives a short distance along the road.
The car begins moving slowly and follows the direction of the road.

image_requirements: 公共汽车主体可辨，道路环境与运动方向明确。
prompt_examples: The bus moves steadily past the surrounding street scene.
The bus slowly pulls forward along the road.

image_requirements: 货车或相近运输车辆可辨，车轮与道路空间足够。
prompt_examples: The truck travels forward with a steady motion.
The truck rolls slowly through the visible scene.

image_requirements: 铁路车辆与轨道或站台可辨，运动方向由图像支持。
prompt_examples: The train moves smoothly along the visible tracks.
The train slowly passes the stationary platform or nearby surroundings.

image_requirements: 工程或农业车辆可辨，地面和可动部件不过小。
prompt_examples: The vehicle advances slowly while its visible working parts move gently.
The vehicle makes a short controlled movement across the ground.

image_requirements: 至少两辆主要车辆与道路关系清晰，不依赖新车凭空出现。
prompt_examples: The visible vehicles move along the road while maintaining their relative lanes.
The vehicles progress slowly through the scene at slightly different speeds.

strata.primary_image_acceptance: 船艇、飞机、直升机或无人机为主要语义；水面/空域与物体姿态必须兼容短时运动。

image_requirements: 小船及水面可辨，若有桨须与人物及水面位置合理。
prompt_examples: The small boat moves gently across the water, leaving soft ripples behind it.
The small boat slowly changes direction as the water moves around its hull.

image_requirements: 船体、帆与水面可辨，帆不被大面积裁断。
prompt_examples: The sailboat moves slowly while the sail shifts with the breeze.
The sailboat glides across the water as small waves meet its hull.

image_requirements: 大型船只主体及水面环境可辨。
prompt_examples: The ship proceeds steadily through the water with a gentle wake.
The ship moves slowly relative to the distant shoreline.

image_requirements: 可辨水上器具已处于水面，运动空间足够。
prompt_examples: The watercraft travels smoothly across the surface and leaves a narrow wake.
The watercraft makes a gentle turn on the water.

image_requirements: 飞机已处于空中，轮廓清楚且周围空域足够。
prompt_examples: The airplane flies steadily across the sky.
The airplane makes a slight bank while continuing forward.

image_requirements: 飞机与跑道或停机坪可辨，初始状态支持地面滑行。
prompt_examples: The airplane taxis slowly along the visible ground path.
The airplane moves forward on the runway while the background remains stationary.

image_requirements: 直升机轮廓与旋翼位置可辨，悬停或飞行环境合理。
prompt_examples: The helicopter hovers with its rotor turning and makes a small controlled shift.
The helicopter moves slowly sideways while maintaining a steady altitude.

image_requirements: 无人机或小型航空器足够大以辨结构，背景可作为运动参照。
prompt_examples: The small aircraft hovers and then moves a short distance forward.
The small aircraft makes a gentle turn while staying at nearly the same height.

strata.primary_image_acceptance: 非生物物件或机械部件为主要对象；可见手可作为操作辅助，完整人物动作占主导时改归人物层。

image_requirements: 杯、瓶或相近容器可辨，支撑面稳定。
prompt_examples: The visible container slowly rotates on its supporting surface.
The container makes a small controlled movement and comes to rest.

image_requirements: 工具和作用对象均已存在，接触区域可辨。
prompt_examples: The visible tool makes a small deliberate movement against its target surface.
The tool is carefully repositioned and then resumes the visible task.

image_requirements: 玩具或可动摆件完整可辨，运动部件可识别。
prompt_examples: The toy moves gently, with its visible parts following the motion.
The small object slowly turns and then settles into place.

image_requirements: 相接机械部件清楚，避免齿轮关系在原图中已不成立。
prompt_examples: The visible gears rotate together with a steady, coordinated motion.
The mechanism starts turning slowly while its supporting frame stays fixed.

image_requirements: 指针或小机械部件在分辨率下可辨。
prompt_examples: The visible pointer or mechanical part advances gradually.
The small mechanism moves continuously while the casing remains still.

image_requirements: 门、盒盖或铰链等开合关系可辨，活动空间充足。
prompt_examples: The hinged part opens slowly and pauses.
The movable part gently closes toward its frame.

image_requirements: 球、轮或圆柱物体与支撑面可辨。
prompt_examples: The round object rolls a short distance across the surface.
The object slowly rolls and changes direction slightly before coming to rest.

image_requirements: 悬挂物和连接点或支撑关系可辨。
prompt_examples: The hanging object swings gently from side to side.
The suspended object makes a small turn and gradually settles.

strata.primary_image_acceptance: 食物、花叶、果实等为主要近景对象；大范围山林或连续水体为主时归S11。

image_requirements: 单朵或少量花朵可辨，花瓣不被严重裁断。
prompt_examples: The flower petals move gently in a light breeze.
The flower sways slightly while the background remains soft and steady.

image_requirements: 近景枝叶结构可辨，叶片与枝条连接合理。
prompt_examples: The leaves and thin branches sway gently together.
A light breeze moves through the visible leaves with small differences in timing.

image_requirements: 果实或蔬菜为主要近景对象，支撑或悬挂关系清楚。
prompt_examples: The visible fruit shifts gently with its supporting branch or surface.
The fruit makes a slight natural movement while its shape remains consistent.

image_requirements: 盆器与植物整体可辨，留有叶片摆动空间。
prompt_examples: The plant leaves move gently while the pot stays still.
The upper branches of the plant sway slightly and then settle.

image_requirements: 食物与容器可辨，prompt所需蒸汽与热食语义相符。
prompt_examples: Thin steam rises gently from the visible food.
Soft wisps of steam drift upward above the dish.

image_requirements: 容器和液体/食材起始关系在图像中已存在，可短时延续。
prompt_examples: The visible liquid pours smoothly into the receiving container.
The stream of liquid continues gently and makes small ripples where it lands.

image_requirements: 面团或柔软食材及施力对象可辨，动作可由初始状态延续。
prompt_examples: The soft food is gently pressed and changes shape gradually.
The dough slowly stretches as the visible contact continues.

image_requirements: 锅内或加热表面的食物可辨，变化方向由语义支持。
prompt_examples: Small bubbles and gentle movement appear across the cooking surface.
The visible food simmers softly with localized changes on its surface.

strata.primary_image_acceptance: 建筑、街区或基础设施整体为主要对象；相机运动属于二级标签，不能另占一个主语义层。

image_requirements: 建筑立面有可辨直线、窗与细节，冻结裁剪后仍保留主要结构。
prompt_examples: The view moves gently across the building facade, revealing its windows and surface details.
The viewpoint slowly shifts along the facade while the building remains structurally stable.

image_requirements: 街道空间、建筑边界和纵深关系可辨。
prompt_examples: The view advances slowly along the street.
The viewpoint moves gently through the visible street scene.

image_requirements: 桥梁与支撑环境可辨，主要连接关系不被裁断。
prompt_examples: The view shifts slowly along the bridge and its surrounding space.
The viewpoint gradually reveals another part of the bridge.

image_requirements: 完整或主体清楚的建筑/纪念物，不要求伪造具体真实地点。
prompt_examples: The view slowly changes around the visible monument.
The viewpoint gently moves to reveal more of the structure and its surroundings.

image_requirements: 多建筑远景与天空分界可辨，主要对象尺度足够。
prompt_examples: The city view changes slowly while the skyline stays coherent.
The viewpoint moves gently across the visible city skyline.

image_requirements: 建成广场或开放空间的地面、边界与主要结构可辨。
prompt_examples: The view moves slowly through the open built space.
The viewpoint gradually reveals the layout of the square.

image_requirements: 道路、隧道口或相近设施结构可辨。
prompt_examples: The view follows the visible path through the infrastructure.
The viewpoint slowly advances while the surrounding structures remain consistent.

image_requirements: 夜间建成空间有明确主体与可辨光源，不能全黑或严重过曝。
prompt_examples: The view moves gently through the night scene while the lights remain steady.
The viewpoint slowly shifts across the illuminated structures.

strata.primary_image_acceptance: 房间、走廊或室内功能区整体为主要对象；人物、产品若占据主任务则归相应主体层。

image_requirements: 房间家具和空间布局可辨，透视关系合理。
prompt_examples: The view moves slowly across the room and its furniture.
The viewpoint gently changes to reveal more of the living space.

image_requirements: 厨房台面、柜体或器具布局可辨。
prompt_examples: The view advances gently through the visible kitchen space.
The viewpoint slowly shifts along the counters and cabinets.

image_requirements: 工具/桌面与室内整体空间可辨，主要结构不被裁断。
prompt_examples: The view moves slowly through the workspace.
The viewpoint gently reveals the arrangement of the work surfaces and tools.

image_requirements: 桌椅和室内结构可辨，空间层次清晰。
prompt_examples: The view shifts gently across the desks and the room.
The viewpoint slowly advances through the visible indoor space.

image_requirements: 货架与过道可辨，细小纹理丰富但主体不全为可读文字。
prompt_examples: The view moves slowly along the aisle and its shelves.
The viewpoint gently turns to reveal the arrangement of the shop interior.

image_requirements: 连续走廊、门框或窗框可辨，纵深线条清晰。
prompt_examples: The view advances slowly down the corridor.
The viewpoint moves gently past the visible doorways.

image_requirements: 大空间的边界、主要设施与前后景关系可辨。
prompt_examples: The view slowly changes across the hall.
The viewpoint gently moves through the open indoor space.

image_requirements: 室内窗、反射面或受光区域可辨，保留动态光照诊断细节。
prompt_examples: The view shifts gently near the window while the light remains stable.
The viewpoint slowly reveals the illuminated surfaces and their reflections.

strata.primary_image_acceptance: 自然场景、流体、云雾或粒子变化为主要对象；单个近景动物/植物已作为主体时归S03/S04/S08。

image_requirements: 山地与前后景层次可辨，主要轮廓保留。
prompt_examples: The view moves slowly across the mountain landscape.
The viewpoint gently reveals more of the distant terrain.

image_requirements: 多树或大片植被构成环境，不能只是单枝植物特写。
prompt_examples: A light breeze moves through the visible vegetation.
The vegetation sways gently across the natural scene.

image_requirements: 流动水体及岸边参照物可辨。
prompt_examples: The water flows steadily along the visible channel.
Small ripples travel downstream around the visible obstacles.

image_requirements: 水面与岸边或固定参照物可辨，波浪可连续演变。
prompt_examples: Gentle waves move toward the shore and recede.
The waves continue rolling across the visible water surface.

image_requirements: 天空和可辨云形为主，不能纯色无结构。
prompt_examples: The clouds drift slowly and change shape gradually.
Thin cloud layers move gently across the sky.

image_requirements: 雨雪环境及静态参照清楚，初始天气与prompt一致。
prompt_examples: The visible precipitation continues falling through the scene.
Small rain or snow particles move steadily past the background.

image_requirements: 雾或烟在图像中已存在，流动空间与背景参照可辨。
prompt_examples: The mist or smoke drifts slowly and curls around the visible space.
Soft wisps of vapor move and gradually spread through the scene.

image_requirements: 可辨火焰与背景，火源关系清楚，不要求破坏性情节。
prompt_examples: The visible flames flicker and change shape naturally.
The flames move continuously while the surrounding solid objects remain stable.

strata.primary_image_acceptance: 明确非写实或抽象图像优先归本层，再记录人物/动物/场景等二级内容标签；避免同时计入写实主体层。

image_requirements: 绘画风格明确，空间或物体轮廓足以支持连续运动。
prompt_examples: The painted scene comes to life with gentle movement while preserving its brushwork.
The painted landscape changes subtly with smooth motion in its visible elements.

image_requirements: 完整或动作部位可辨的卡通角色，肢体与风格统一。
prompt_examples: The cartoon character makes a small expressive gesture.
The illustrated character turns slightly and gives a gentle wave.

image_requirements: 动画风格角色可辨，脸与关键肢体不被严重裁断。
prompt_examples: The animated character blinks, turns their head, and makes a small gesture.
The character shifts their posture slightly while their hair and clothing move gently.

image_requirements: 非写实三维或玩具质感明确，主体与表面细节可辨。
prompt_examples: The stylized three-dimensional object slowly turns in place.
The rendered object makes a small smooth movement while retaining its material appearance.

image_requirements: 分层纸艺或剪纸结构清晰，形变应符合图像材料风格。
prompt_examples: The paper-like elements move gently while keeping their layered appearance.
The cutout shapes make a small coordinated movement.

image_requirements: 像素风格明确，主体轮廓可辨，不能以模糊低清照片替代。
prompt_examples: The pixel-art subject makes a simple smooth movement while preserving the visible style.
The pixel-art scene changes gently through the movement of its main subject.

image_requirements: 可辨几何形状、层次或连接关系，数量不过密以致不可追踪。
prompt_examples: The geometric shapes rotate slowly while keeping their relative arrangement.
The visible shapes shift gently and then settle into a stable configuration.

image_requirements: 纹理有连续结构与方向，避免纯随机噪声图充当自然纹理。
prompt_examples: The abstract pattern flows slowly with continuous changes in its texture.
The visible texture moves gently while preserving its overall structure.

secondary_tags.status: draft allocation targets until image review; observed motion is not inferred from prompt
secondary_tags.note: Coverage targets are overlapping marginals, not a full Cartesian factorial; infeasible proposed pairings are revised before freezing. Preserve primary 8/4/8 quotas.

sampling.panel: One frozen uniformly sampled random-order2048 row sequence per source x generation seed, shared across all4 steps/all40 blocks/all paired arms. Take prefixes before sorting for access. Preserve original order and inverse mapping.
sampling.tubelet: 336 tubelet rows stored separately for temporal diagnostics. Deduplicate storage if useful; do not mix with uniform-panel MSE at equal row weight.
sampling.source_order: Three pre-outcome tag-constrained random slot orders, frozen after real source binding; exact slots in source_order_schedules. Static counts at C12/C24/C48/C96 are2/3/6/12; maintain primary1/2/4/8 counts. Reordering after observing model errors is prohibited.
sampling.secondary_mix_caveat: Primary-stratum proportions are constant; finer subtopic coverage expands. Track that change, and describe this contrast as broader source and fine-semantic coverage, not a pure source-count effect with every secondary distribution fixed.
sampling.alternate_order_fit_policy: P1 all eight unique data configurations; P2/P3 initial fixed-total-row C12/C48 at main lambda only. C96 identical across orders, reuse it.

development_order.note: DEV12 takes first source per stratum; static controls are not concentrated in the first wave.

calibration_selection.normalization: Same registered source-equal gated loss and relative-prior penalty definition across sample sizes; recompute training-only normalization explicitly.

cv.C12: Fixed-lambda low-sample diagnostic; no borrowed projections, priors or selected lambda from a larger calibration set. No balanced K-fold claim.
cv.C24: Two source-disjoint folds, one source per primary stratum in each validation fold.
cv.C48: Four source-disjoint folds, one source per primary stratum per validation fold.
cv.C96: Four source-disjoint folds, two sources per primary stratum per validation fold.

calibration_selection.prior_policy: Rebuild every prior/projection/normalizer learned from the current CAL split inside each training fold. A separately frozen legacy Q1 baseline trained only on disjoint legacy sources remains a fixed external reference; any new-CAL Q1 fit must be rebuilt within folds.
calibration_selection.reporting: Main fixed-lambda curve and CAL-CV-selected sensitivity are separate tables. DEV may guide development, never hidden tuning reported as confirmation. No CONFIRM field may be used for selection.

capture_waves.pilot: First two trajectories count inside these 36; neutral/ID failure stops collection for repair.

capture_budget.capacity_note: 2 TiB is a planning capacity gate, not proof of available free space. Freeze actual redundancy, manifests, native audit tensors and temporary space separately. Do not silently reduce full-80-site CAL coverage.
capture_budget.capacity_gate_note: Minimum planning workspace2TiB excludes separately provisioned archive redundancy; actual required free space from full producer manifest is binding.

system_evaluation.conditional_eighth_arm: New_FFN_without_Attention only for a separately frozen FFN-only or interaction claim; add 2*N complete generations to that scope. Missing ICC/Chipmunk implementations are MISSING_ASSET, not silently dropped competitors.
system_evaluation.dense_reuse: The 96 DEV Dense trajectories in shared capture are part of the 672 DEV arm trajectories if the full numerical/source/noise identity matches; production timing still needs probe-free measurement.
system_evaluation.timing_policy: Exactly3 probe-free technical repetitions per source x seed x arm in the frozen default scope; first repeat supplies quality video. Extra repeats require a new bounded scope. Repeats do not increase independent n.

statistics.aggregation: Average seeds/conditions inside each image cluster, then source-equal within each primary stratum, then equal across 12 strata. Equal 8/4/8 quotas make this equal to source mean in each full role.
readouts: high and low expert results separately
confidence intervals clustered by original image
statistics.N_selection: Select N once from development-only source-level variance, valid-motion rate, prespecified effect or noninferiority margin, and resource budget before any CONFIRM outcome is opened. Balance each selected N across 12 strata; 144/192 require 48/96 additional real unexposed image clusters.
statistics.motion_missingness: Determine motion eligibility only with the preregistered Dense-based rule; retain every source for applicable quality outcomes. Use n_motion, not total N, for motion precision/power. Do not replace an unresponsive Dense source after seeing candidate differences.
statistics.interpretation: N96 gives about 0.286 source-SD detectable gap for one paired frozen endpoint under the normal approximation. This is conditional planning, not a significance or universal coverage guarantee. Per-stratum N8 supports descriptive heterogeneity, not 12 separate well-powered acceptance claims.
statistics.confirmation_decision: PASS only when the frozen primary superiority and all required noninferiority criteria pass; interval crossing a boundary is INCONCLUSIVE; contradiction is FAIL. Do not extend N after looking at candidate effects unless a separately preregistered sequential design governs it.
statistics.development_subtopic_variance_limit: DEV has4/8 subtopics per stratum whereas CONFIRM covers8/8. DEV variance is a working estimate, not proof for all confirmation subtopics; report variance-inflation sensitivity and prospective power for missing subtopics before N freeze.
statistics.planning_SD_policy: For continuous guard planning use at least max(1.25 * DEV paired source SD, development bootstrap80% upper confidence bound of SD); additionally report1.5xSD sensitivity. This is a conservative planning convention, not a distribution-free variance bound.
statistics.joint_power: Single-endpoint0.286SD does not promise joint80% power for all guards. Estimate joint success probability with paired source vectors or use beta_j=0.20/K across K necessary tests; binary guards use paired-discordance counts and rare-event bounds.
statistics.local_screen_estimand: For each source/expert: average absolute MSE over the prespecified sites and seeds for each arm, then compute(candidate-baseline)/baseline; average the two expert ratios equally, then image/stratum equally. Denominator below frozen CAL numeric floor is reported separately with absolute differences, not silently removed.
statistics.time_estimand: Median of exactly3 repeats per source/seed/arm; log of paired arm ratio per seed; average seeds within source, then source-equal/stratum-equal. Exponentiation yields geometric mean paired time ratio.

sufficiency_and_expansion.base_scope: Collect the full planned CAL96/DEV48 unless an engineering, data-identity or resource gate fails; a negative early curve is not a reason to rename CAL24 sufficient or leave planned coverage silent.
sufficiency_and_expansion.rank_warning: Once the calibration design has full column rank, omega may be approximately zero by construction. It no longer establishes distributional coverage. Keep regularized spectral/effective-dimension or leverage diagnostics, source-heldout risk, class coverage and learning-curve uncertainty.
sufficiency_and_expansion.cal_expansion: If CAL48-to-CAL96 or 96x256-to-96x1024 remains decision-changing, or class/regularized coverage is insufficient, register a balanced CAL192 extension. Reuse old prefixes; acquire real new clusters, never duplicated crops or seeds as sources.
sufficiency_and_expansion.dev_expansion: If source-level intervals cannot resolve the decision boundary, freeze additional balanced development clusters (48 to 96) before reading their results; label all such adaptive development exploratory.
sufficiency_and_expansion.stop: A plateau and sufficiently precise heldout comparison can close the tested linear recipe at the registered data/regularization range. It does not prove all fixed linear operators impossible. Broaden hypotheses or advance the declared nonlinear controls as the evidence requires.
sufficiency_and_expansion.no_confirmation_peeking: An inconclusive confirmation remains inconclusive. A new method or a post-result new sample requires a new version and new independent confirmation, or the preregistered sequential protocol.
sufficiency_and_expansion.confirm_subtopic_mix: For N144, every stratum has8 subtopics once plus4 extra with balanced fixed subtopic choices across strata; N192 has2 sources per subtopic. Freeze exact extension list and analysis weights before results. Preserve static12.5% overall.
